naicsTitle: Foundation, Structure, and Building Exterior Contractors
title: OSHA's most-cited standards: roofing, framing and exterior contractors (NAICS 2381)
seoTitle: Roofing safety: OSHA citations across NAICS 2381 trades
description: OSHA's most-cited standards for NAICS 2381 contractors, FY2022–FY2026: fall protection leads, then ladders, fall training, scaffolds and eye protection.
opening: OSHA cited 1926.501, the duty to have fall protection, more than any other standard in foundation, structure, and building exterior contractors (NAICS 2381) in FY2022–FY2026, followed by 1926.1053 on ladders and 1926.503 on fall protection training.
patternsSummary: Falls lead the NAICS 2381 list: 1926.501, 1926.503 and 1926.502 all sit in Subpart M (Fall Protection), while ladder rules (1926.1053 and 1926.1060, Subpart X) and scaffold rules (1926.451, 1926.453 and 1926.454, Subpart L) cover the equipment crews use to reach height. Personal protective equipment comes next, with 1926.102 on eye and face protection and 1926.100 on head protection, and 1910.1200 (hazard communication) and 1926.1153 (respirable crystalline silica) deal with chemical and dust exposure. The data spans 130,632 citations from 68,723 inspections over FY2022–FY2026, with 140 standards cited at least 5 times.
penaltiesSummary: The median penalty in NAICS 2381 over FY2022–FY2026 was $3,457, and the middle half of penalties ran from $2,113 to $4,839. Of all citations, 75% were classed serious, 10% repeat, 1% willful and 14% other-than-serious.
